page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.1-16 is a flexible virtual machine instance within the Optimized family. It is built on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6354 processor operating at a base frequency of 3.0 GHz. The instance configuration provides 1 physical core with 2 threads per core, yielding 2 dedicated vCPUs alongside 16.0 GB of memory. This yields an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, matching a memory-dense resource balance.

The instance provides dedicated compute allocation without CPU oversubscription. It does not include integrated local NVMe storage, meaning persistent storage must be provisioned via remote block volumes. Additionally, the instance contains no discrete GPU hardware. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

From a resource allocation standpoint, the 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio offers efficient resource density for workloads requiring moderate computational power combined with substantial memory overhead. Suitable applications include in-memory caching systems, small-to-medium databases, lightweight data analysis, and memory-sensitive backend services.
